description: This file defines the 'Layout' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Design' namespace. The class provides methods to retrieve layout IDs and modules related to the layout system in OpenCart, interacting with the database to fetch layout configurations for specific routes and store modules assigned to layouts and positions.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Model class responsible for retrieving layout and module information in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a given route, returning 0 if no specific layout is found.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches modules assigned to a specific layout ID and position, ordered by their sort order.
